candidates.title: Review store information that may deter buyers

demandEvidence.chore: Is there any missing information—such as reviews, policies, contact details, or business background—that would make you hesitate to buy?
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Is there any missing information—such as reviews, policies, contact details, or business background—that would make you hesitate to buy?

ease.reason: A fictional store checklist can organize the listed information, but no review method or implementation reference is supplied.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: an online shop might pay for a store review; one feedback question does not validate payment.

feasibility.reason: A test can use fictional store details, but no repeat process or evaluation standard is established.

autonomy.reason: A model can sort missing-information notes; a person must judge trust and accuracy.

evidence.reason: The fresh question names reviews, policies, contact details and background, but gives no recurring demand or method.

candidates.reason: Experiment: an operator supplies fictional store-page text covering reviews, policies, contact details and business background; a manual run returns a checklist of missing items, compared with a prepared checklist, and a person verifies any advice. Below threshold (24/5 = 4.8): one question gives no repeatable method. This also overlaps the online-shop customer in recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6.

demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m customizing the Dawn theme and looking for a way to update the unit price dynamically via JavaScript when a customer selects a different product variant.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a Shopify merchant might pay for theme customization; payment is not evidenced.

feasibility.reason: A sample variant-price calculation is testable, but product rules and live theme behavior are absent.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a small business may pay for Make repair; this request does not establish payment or a specific failure.

feasibility.reason: A fictional test can review one scenario outline, but the missing fault details limit usefulness.

autonomy.reason: Make can route an error through a configured handler; a person must diagnose and decide how to finish the build.

Reference 428eda549e557f199c3af452 supports interception and configured routing only. Below threshold (24/5 = 4.8); no failure is named, and no new evidence changes the prior detailed refusal.
